definitions.explanation: The act of taking part in a competition, event, or performance.

examples.japanese: オリンピックに{出場|しゅつじょう}することが{夢|ゆめ}だ。
examples.english: My dream is to participate in the Olympics.

examples.japanese: {怪我|けが}で{試合|しあい}に{出場|しゅつじょう}できなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't participate in the match due to an injury.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{今大会|こんたいかい}で5{回目|かいめ}の{出場|しゅつじょう}となる。{過去|かこ}4{回|かい}は{入賞|にゅうしょう}を{逃|のが}しているが、{今回|こんかい}こそ{優勝|ゆうしょう}を{狙|ねら}っている。
examples.english: This will be her fifth time participating in this tournament. She missed placing in the past four times, but this time she's aiming for victory.

notes:
{出場|しゅつじょう} refers to participation or entry in competitions, events, or performances.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {出場|しゅつじょう}する (to participate, to enter)
- ○○に{出場|しゅつじょう}する (to participate in XX)
- {出場|しゅつじょう}が{決|き}まる (participation is decided/confirmed)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出場|しゅつじょう}{選手|せんしゅ} (participating athlete)
- {出場|しゅつじょう}{資格|しかく} (qualification for entry)
- {出場|しゅつじょう}{回数|かいすう} (number of appearances)
- {出場|しゅつじょう}{停止|ていし} (suspension from participation)
- {初|はつ}{出場|しゅつじょう} (first-time participation)
- {連続|れんぞく}{出場|しゅつじょう} (consecutive appearances)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出場|しゅつじょう}: entry in competition/event
- {参加|さんか}: participation (general, broader meaning)
- {出演|しゅつえん}: appearance (in TV, movies, shows)
